integrity: Explicit exact proof, disjoint spectral census, and two reproducibility programs; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to ordered four-point injections and finite abelian groups of order at least four, unnormalized counting convolution. Direct finite tests corroborate but do not establish the universal proof. Classical equivalent computations may predate this tabulation.
title: The six-colour Fourier rank resonance for injective four-tuples and its involution-sensitive signed spectrum
